description: Edit a branch protection rule. Only fields you pass are changed; omitted fields are left untouched.

approvals_whitelist_usernames.description: Usernames whose approving reviews count toward required approvals (comma-separated). Replaces the existing list.

block_on_outdated_branch.description: Block merge when the branch is behind its base

dismiss_stale_approvals.description: Dismiss approvals when new commits are pushed

enable_approvals_whitelist.description: Restrict whose reviews count toward required approvals to the approvals whitelist

enable_merge_whitelist.description: Restrict who may merge pull requests to the merge whitelist

enable_push.description: Allow direct pushes to the protected branch

enable_push_whitelist.description: Restrict direct pushes to the push whitelist (users/teams) instead of all writers

enable_status_check.description: Require status checks to pass before merging

merge_whitelist_usernames.description: Usernames allowed to merge pull requests (comma-separated). Replaces the existing list.

push_whitelist_usernames.description: Usernames allowed to push to the protected branch (comma-separated, e.g. "alice,bot"). Each must be a collaborator with write access. Replaces the existing list.

require_signed_commits.description: Require commits on the protected branch to be signed

required_approvals.description: Number of required approving reviews before merge

rule.description: Branch protection rule name (the rule_name; Forgejo defaults it to branch_name)

name: edit_branch_protection
